golden_keep.title: Black-envelope opening
golden_keep.evidence: A concrete intake-printer action, blank credential and single 0 create a personal question before explanation. The reader is invited to act rather than being told about a world at a distance.

golden_keep.title: Honest activity range and connected promise
golden_keep.evidence: The book actually contains visual comparison, symbol sequencing, route rules, clocks, physical reconstruction, spatial deduction and a cumulative mystery. The team promise is fulfilled through the Comms.

golden_keep.title: Six distinct family viewpoints
golden_keep.evidence: Mimi can need help, Luli can be wrong or hungry, Dilo has competitive technical confidence, Nini contributes people-focused noticing, Alio supplies routes and imagination, and Bibi verifies memory. No child is the designated fool.

golden_keep.title: Recruit hook becomes earned certification
golden_keep.evidence: The empty sixth hook is planted early and paid off visibly. The certificate is a meaningful change of role rather than a duplicate recruit card. The paperwork joke allows warmth without forced praise.

golden_keep.title: Companion is a lead rather than guilty
golden_keep.evidence: The standard map instruction and Case 14 explicitly distinguish contact, imperfect memory and guilt. This supports a family mystery without inviting unfair accusations.

golden_keep.title: Cup closure and 071 archive trail
golden_keep.evidence: The apparent Cup mystery actually closes: the returned Cup, signed form, wrong image and 017/071 mismatch fit together. The older photo remains useful evidence rather than an unresolved theft bait.

golden_keep.title: Comic object games early in the book
golden_keep.evidence: Inspector Glitter, the competitive locker, dragon-spoon history and the building rejecting a route all have different comic structures. They do not repeat one stock line.

golden_keep.title: Bibi checks familiarity instead of pretending certainty
golden_keep.evidence: This is an active mentor with limits, not an all-knowing adult withholding the answer. The cake exchange relieves tension without mocking old age.

golden_keep.title: Phone/oat-bar setup and payoff
golden_keep.evidence: Mimi's early lost-phone habit receives a specific object-and-paperwork payoff. The joke is shared by the family rather than at a child's expense.

golden_keep.title: Parrot interview and handler
golden_keep.evidence: The snack negotiation is accessible to younger readers, while Dilo's interview-notebook formality gives adults and older readers a second comic layer. Consulting the handler is appropriate within the story.

golden_keep.title: Memory error and hat humor remain kind
golden_keep.evidence: Luli contributes her own ordinary mistake, and Bibi answers the hat joke with confidence. The story does not punish a witness or embarrass a child for imperfect memory.

golden_keep.title: Dilo learns through action
golden_keep.evidence: Dilo corrects his watch and crosses off 0:07 himself; later he checks the scanner before proposing a ghost. Luli notices without making a speech. This gives the Comms an accumulating emotional arc.

golden_keep.title: Torn-note repair changes tone
golden_keep.evidence: The missing joke is purposeful. Dilo's mistake raises the stakes, and the team gives him a useful checking role. The reader is still the person who fits the pieces.

golden_keep.title: Later Comms show changed habits
golden_keep.evidence: The scoreboard exchanges, voluntarily paused dramatic theory and adults admitting their own unsupported confidence vary the humor and demonstrate RuleZero before naming it.

golden_keep.title: Saved-map payoff and useful parcel
golden_keep.evidence: Fourteen maps return as evidence, Nini supplies the viewpoint shift, and the parcel's overlay sleeve has a concrete later use. Case 01 is explicitly excluded from the meta without being erased from recruitment history.

golden_keep.title: Calm support before the hardest map
golden_keep.evidence: The family offers space and time rather than speed, score, teasing or a lecture. This helps the largest grid remain inviting across mixed ability levels.

golden_keep.title: Final lock uses earned inputs
golden_keep.evidence: The four fields are legible, come from previous work and include the reader's own call sign. No new cipher or arbitrary last-minute test replaces the effort already invested.

golden_keep.title: Room Zero solution closes Book 1
golden_keep.evidence: The room purpose, Bibi note authorship, dormant route, matching/routing limits, vacancy and invitation are explained before the badge. The system does not manufacture cases or solve the reader's puzzles.

golden_keep.title: Sequel has a new evidence object after completed closure
golden_keep.evidence: Book 1's log is explicitly closed before the release flap is lifted. The cut-out team photograph and RETURN BEFORE THE FIRST MEETING create a specific new question. Mimi explicitly keeps Case 03 solved. No false claim that the triangle matches an earlier clue is made.

golden_keep.title: Hints offer help without shame
golden_keep.evidence: Readers choose the amount of help. The book counts tool use as solving and allows reading the solution to learn a route. Do not turn certification into a no-hints reward.

golden_keep.title: Existing worked solution exemplars
golden_keep.evidence: These solutions connect evidence to a conclusion: row/column elimination, route-edge time, intersecting date limits, physical tear joins and fading mud. They provide models for improving the weaker solution pages.

reader_assessment: The final text fulfills its family detective puzzle-adventure promise. Clearer help, map terms and worked routes improve access; the retained shorter cases keep the larger-map load from becoming one unbroken difficulty demand. The accumulated evidence, quiet repair scene, sixth-hook certification and specific new archive file give the book a complete first ending with a credible reason to continue. No additional broad rewrite is warranted.
